generation_description: New ammunition-resupply icon in the reference retro 1990s pixel-art PC-game UI style. Navy inset, ivory and gray stepped bevel, olive ammunition box with three brass rifle cartridges and a green curved resupply arrow. No words or numbers. Opaque square background, crisp pixel clusters, legible beside shield/blink at 48x48.
pipeline: RGB, nearest-neighbour resize once from generated original to 64x64; runtime centre-samples to 48x48. E keycap and four charge pips are code-drawn.
